    Sharing

    • shares.list List shares of an environment
    • shares.preview Preview what a share would show
    • shares.create Share part of an environment with someone
    • shares.update Change a share's permission
    • shares.revoke Revoke a share
    • shares.incoming List shares with you
    • shares.requests.list List re-share requests
    • shares.requests.create Ask the owner to share it on
    • shares.requests.decide Approve or deny a re-share request
    • proposals.list List share additions
    • proposals.approve Approve a share addition
    • proposals.deny Deny a share addition

    shares.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares MCP shares_list

    List shares of an environment

    Who you share this environment (or parts of it) with: each share's recipient, permission, scope in words and counts, plus the pending re-share requests on them (approve or deny with shares.requests.decide). Only the environment's owner can list them; anyone else gets 404.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    shares[].recipientEmailstringrequired
    shares[].permissionenumrequiredOne of view, comment, edit.
    shares[].addsenumWhat the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of off, approve, direct.
    shares[].scopeobjectrequired
    shares[].namestring
    shares[].createdAtstringrequired
    shares[].createdBystringEmail of the owner who shared it.

    shares[].revokedAtstring | nullrequired

    shares.preview read

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares/preview MCP shares_preview

    Preview what a share would show

    Exactly what a recipient would see for a scope, before you share: chart cards, co-owner stubs (name only), projects, timeline items and DevOps cards, with counts and a tip when the scope may surprise people. Nothing is stored. Owner only.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    scopeobjectrequiredWhat to share. Names are matched like everywhere else (id first, then the name, ignoring case), against your own records.
    scope.kindenumrequiredenvironment (everything in it), project (a project with its timeline items and DevOps cards), label (the DevOps cards with a label), person (a chart card and everything connected below it, with their projects) or nodes (hand-picked chart cards, nothing below them). One of environment, project, label, person, nodes.
    scope.projectstringFor kind project: the project, id or name.
    scope.labelstringFor kind label: the DevOps label, id or name.
    scope.nodestringFor kind person: the chart card to start from (a person or any card), id or name.
    scope.nodesstring[]For kind nodes: the chart cards, ids or names.
    scope.chartstringOptional: only this chart's cards and lines (chart id or name, or "active").
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },

      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "enum": [
            "environment",

          "description": "environment (everything in it), project (a project with its timeline items and DevOps cards), label (the DevOps cards with a label), person (a chart card and everything connected below it, with their projects) or nodes (hand-picked chart cards, nothing below them)."
        },
        "project": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 200,
          "description": "For kind project: the project, id or name."
        },
        "label": {

      "additionalProperties": false,

    }

  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    shares.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares MCP shares_create

    Share part of an environment with someone

    Gives another Flow user (by email) access to part of your environment: they see it as linked records they can add to their own environments, and edit or comment when the permission allows. Two steps, because this grants a person access to data: without confirm: true it only answers with the preview (what they would see) and stores nothing (200, created false). Show that preview to your user and ask them before you call again with confirm: true, which creates the share (201). Sharing the same scope with the same person again changes the permission instead (existing true). Only the environment's owner can share it; records shared with you (ids sh.…) cannot be shared on: ask their owner with shares.requests.create. Needs a key with write access to this environment. The share records the key's name, shown in Settings › Sharing as "Created by".

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    recipientEmailstringrequiredWho to share with: their email (the account they sign in to Flow with).
    scopeobjectrequiredWhat to share. Names are matched like everywhere else (id first, then the name, ignoring case), against your own records.
    scope.kindenumrequiredenvironment (everything in it), project (a project with its timeline items and DevOps cards), label (the DevOps cards with a label), person (a chart card and everything connected below it, with their projects) or nodes (hand-picked chart cards, nothing below them). One of environment, project, label, person, nodes.
    scope.projectstringFor kind project: the project, id or name.
    scope.labelstringFor kind label: the DevOps label, id or name.
    scope.nodestringFor kind person: the chart card to start from (a person or any card), id or name.
    scope.nodesstring[]For kind nodes: the chart cards, ids or names.
    scope.chartstringOptional: only this chart's cards and lines (chart id or name, or "active").
    permissionenumview (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of view, comment, edit.
    addsenumEdit shares only: what the recipient may add to your environment inside the share (cards, timeline items, projects, mind map cards). off (the default), approve (each addition waits for you: proposals.list, proposals.approve, proposals.deny) or direct (added at once). View and comment shares are always off. One of off, approve, direct.
    namestringOptional label for the share.
    confirmbooleanfalse (the default): preview only, nothing is shared. true: create the share. Only send true after your user has seen the preview and agreed.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "recipientEmail": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 254,
      "description": "Who to share with: their email (the account they sign in to Flow with)."
    },
    "scope": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "enum": [
            "environment",
            "project",
            "label",
            "person",
            "nodes"
          ],
          "description": "environment (everything in it), project (a project with its timeline items and DevOps cards), label (the DevOps cards with a label), person (a chart card and everything connected below it, with their projects) or nodes (hand-picked chart cards, nothing below them)."
        },
        "project": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 200,
          "description": "For kind project: the project, id or name."
        },
        "label": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 200,
          "description": "For kind label: the DevOps label, id or name."
        },
        "node": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 200,
          "description": "For kind person: the chart card to start from (a person or any card), id or name."
        },
        "nodes": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "maxItems": 2000,
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "Chart card id or name."
          },
          "description": "For kind nodes: the chart cards, ids or names."
        },
        "chart": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 200,

        }
      },
      "required": [
        "kind"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "What to share. Names are matched like everywhere else (id first, then the name, ignoring case), against your own records."
    },
    "permission": {
      "enum": [
        "view",
        "comment",
        "edit"
      ],
      "description": "view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment).",
      "default": "view"
    },
    "adds": {
      "enum": [
        "off",
        "approve",
        "direct"
      ],
      "description": "Edit shares only: what the recipient may add to your environment inside the share (cards, timeline items, projects, mind map cards). off (the default), approve (each addition waits for you: proposals.list, proposals.approve, proposals.deny) or direct (added at once). View and comment shares are always off."
    },

    shares.update write

    PATCH /api/v1/shares/{share} MCP shares_update

    Change a share's permission

    Set what the recipient may do: permission view, comment or edit, and for edit shares adds (whether they may add records). Send either or both. Lowering an edit share to view or comment turns additions off. Owner only (anyone else gets 404); a revoked share gets 409.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    sharestringrequiredShare id (from shares.list or shares.incoming).
    permissionenumview (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of view, comment, edit.
    addsenumEdit shares only: what the recipient may add to your environment inside the share (cards, timeline items, projects, mind map cards). off (the default), approve (each addition waits for you: proposals.list, proposals.approve, proposals.deny) or direct (added at once). View and comment shares are always off. One of off, approve, direct.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "share": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Share id (from shares.list or shares.incoming)."
    },
    "permission": {
      "enum": [
        "view",
        "comment",
        "edit"
      ],
      "description": "view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment)."
    },
    "adds": {
      "enum": [
        "off",
        "approve",
        "direct"
      ],
      "description": "Edit shares only: what the recipient may add to your environment inside the share (cards, timeline items, projects, mind map cards). off (the default), approve (each addition waits for you: proposals.list, proposals.approve, proposals.deny) or direct (added at once). View and comment shares are always off."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "share"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    shares.requests.create write

    POST /api/v1/shares/{share}/requests MCP shares_requests_create

    Ask the owner to share it on

    You cannot share what is shared with you, but you can ask its owner to share the same records with someone else. The permission defaults to yours and cannot be more than yours. The owner approves (maybe at a lower permission) or denies it in Settings › Sharing or with shares.requests.decide.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    sharestringrequiredShare id (from shares.list or shares.incoming).
    toEmailstringrequiredWho it should be shared with.
    permissionenumview (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of view, comment, edit.
    notestringA note for the owner.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "share": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Share id (from shares.list or shares.incoming)."
    },
    "toEmail": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 254,
      "description": "Who it should be shared with."
    },
    "permission": {
      "enum": [
        "view",
        "comment",
        "edit"
      ],
      "description": "view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment)."
    },
    "note": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 500,
      "description": "A note for the owner."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "share",
    "toEmail"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    request.newShareIdstring | null

    shares.requests.decide write

    POST /api/v1/share-requests/{request} MCP shares_requests_decide

    Approve or deny a re-share request

    The owner's answer to a request from shares.requests.list. approve: true creates a new share of the same scope with the person asked for, at the requested permission or the lower one you pass; false denies it. Like shares.create, approving grants a person access: show the request to your user first. A request already decided gets 409.

    FieldTypeDescription
    requeststringrequiredRequest id.
    approvebooleanrequired
    permissionenumOptional: approve at this permission (not more than requested). One of view, comment, edit.

    proposals.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals MCP proposals_list

    List share additions

    Records that recipients of this environment's edit shares added while their share needs your approval (role owner), and the ones you added from this environment to someone else's share (role proposer). status: pending (the default), approved, denied, withdrawn, or applied (added at once by a share that allows it). preview says what each one adds. Decide with proposals.approve or proposals.deny; set what a share allows in the app (Settings › Sharing).

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    statusenumOne of pending, approved, denied, applied, withdrawn.
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "pending",
        "approved",
        "denied",
        "applied",
        "withdrawn"
      ],
      "default": "pending"
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    proposals.approve write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals/{proposal}/approve MCP proposals_approve

    Approve a share addition

    Add a pending proposal's records to this environment, owned by you (cards get your next numbers). The recipient then sees them as ordinary shared records. Only the environment's owner can; a decided one is refused with 409 proposal_decided, and one that no longer fits its share (what it was added to is gone or no longer shared) with 409 proposal_out_of_scope.
